positive_terms: Third-party standard of conduct used in policy is verifiable through independent certifying or verifying bodies, which have defined and rigorous assessment procedures that avoid conflicts of interest and are compliant with ISO guidance on accreditation and verification procedures or Article 5(2) of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008
第三方行为标准的独立验证
说明第三方行为标准是否可由独立认证或验证机构核查，且其程序避免利益冲突并符合ISO或欧盟相关法规要求。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
